components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0f172a; color: #ffffff; padding: 0.85rem 1.75rem; font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-size: 0.92rem; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; border: 2.5px solid #0f172a; border-radius: 2px; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0px #0f172a; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.1s ease, box-shadow 0.1s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1e293b; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translate(3px, 3px); box-shadow: 1px 1px 0px #0f172a; }

components.name: Ticket Tab
components.css: .ds-tab-btn { border: 2px solid #0f172a; border-bottom: none; border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0; background: #f8fafc; padding: 0.65rem 1.25rem 0.75rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab-idx { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.65rem; font-weight: 800; color: #2563eb; } .ds-tab-title { font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; color: #0f172a; }

components.name: Stamped Fallback Badge
components.description: Official rubber-stamp indicator for non-trading trading-day fallback.
components.css: .ds-badge-fallback { border: 2px solid #dc2626; background: #fef2f2; color: #dc2626; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 0.2rem 0.5rem; border-radius: 2px; transform: rotate(-1.5deg); display: inline-block; }

narrative.northStar: The Jet-Age Ticket Ledger & Swiss Neo-Brutalist Observatory
narrative.overview: Rial Scope marries the tactile discipline of vintage airline coupon wallets and carbon-copy transit manifests with the unapologetic structural rigor of Swiss Neo-Brutalism. Designed for an offline-first local deployment, the interface presents financial conversions, 75-year historical exchange rate trajectories, and purchasing power deltas as verified flight coupons and official stamped registers.
keyCharacteristics: Aviation Navy Mesh: Deep navy desktop background with subtle coordinates.
Perforated Ticket Coupons: Multi-leg ticket wallet structure with top tear-off tabs and semicircle punch notch cutouts.
Architectural Ink Borders: Heavy 2px to 3px solid ink borders and hard 6px offset shadows.
Official Stamped Seals: Red and green validation marks indicating fallback status and deltas.
Tabular Carbon-Copy Alignment: Strict monospace data columns for all rates and dates.

rules.name: The Ink-and-Stamp Rule
rules.body: Color is never applied as decorative ambient glows or soft pastels. Color exists strictly as solid structural ink, carbon-copy lines, or official pressed rubber stamps.

rules.name: The Tabular Metric Rule
rules.body: Every currency rate, historical date, and financial delta string must be rendered using --font-mono (JetBrains Mono) with tabular numeral alignment.

rules.name: The Hard Offset Rule
rules.body: All shadows must use 0px blur radius with crisp directional offsets. Diffuse or gradient drop shadows are strictly prohibited.

dos: Do use 2px/3px solid black/navy borders (#0f172a) and hard 0-blur offset shadows for all structural cards.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus rings (:focus-visible) with 2-3px outline offsets.
Do render all currency amounts, rates, and dates in JetBrains Mono.
Do style fallback date notifications as official stamped verification marks.
donts: Don't use soft pastel gradients, diffuse blurred drop shadows, or generic rounded SaaS cards.
Don't draw linear interpolation lines across unpopulated historical coverage gaps (e.g. 2010–2011).
Don't use low-contrast text colors; always maintain high-contrast WCAG AAA readability.
